title: Snapping geometry utilities
description: Pure geometry helpers in packages/core/src/engine/snap.ts for Flash 8 snapping: snapToGrid(point, gridW, gridH), snapToGuides(point, guides, tolerance), snapToPixels(point), snapToObject(point, objectBounds[], tolerance) returning snapped Point + snap type. Also snapDistance(a, b) and snapPoint(point, config: SnapConfig) as the main entry point. Export from packages/core/src/engine/index.ts. No UI. See docs/01-documents-stage-scenes.md § Snapping.
